steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and mash 2 ripe bananas with a fork until completely smooth in a large bowl.
Add coconut milk and coconut oil to the mashed banana and stir to combine.
Stir in oat flour, cinnamon, and baking powder until a soft, spreadable batter forms.
Spread the batter evenly onto the parchment paper into a rectangle about 1 cm thick.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the edges are golden and the centre feels set to the touch.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then cut into 16 small finger-sized pieces.
Store in an airtight container at room temperature for 2 days or refrigerate for up to 4 days.
